# Community Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free, welcoming, and constructive experience for everyone.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, respectful, and healthy community focused on collaboration and building great software.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment for our community include:

* Demonstrating courtesy, kindness, and respect toward other people
* Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and technical experiences
* Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
* Taking responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes, and learning from the experience
* Focusing on what is best for the overall community and project collaboration

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

* Harassment, abusive language, or personal attacks of any kind
* Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments
* Publishing others' private information without explicit permission
* Disruptive or unwelcome behavior in project spaces
* Any conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a collaborative technical setting

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior deemed inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

Maintainers have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that do not align with this Code of Conduct.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces—including the GitHub repository, issue trackers, pull requests, and the official Discord server—as well as any public space where an individual represents the project.

## Enforcement & Reporting

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported directly to the project maintainer:
* **Discord:** Direct message to `fs.corrupt` or contact a moderator via our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/fYyJQSGt54).

All reports will be reviewed promptly and handled with discretion.
